notes: The adaptor targets the Flutterwave v4 API (unprefixed /customers, /payment-methods, /charges; OAuth access token sent as Bearer), not v3. Flutterwave publishes a machine spec only for v3 (/api/v3/openapi.json, every path under /v3/), so that was rejected as the wrong version; no v4 spec is public. This OpenAPI 3.0.3 was generated by mechanically parsing the 57 v4 endpoint sections of the vendor's llms-full.txt export (the same structured data the v4 reference pages render), so every documented v4 endpoint is present: 39 paths / 57 operations across customers, charges, orchestrator charges/orders/transfers, orders, payment methods, refunds, chargebacks, settlements, transfers, transfer recipients/senders/rates, virtual accounts, wallets, banks, mobile networks, fees and webhook resend; the refund.completed webhook payload is a component schema. Caveats: (1) the two DELETE operations document no success response, so 204 is assumed; (2) the docs show only the sandbox host (developersandbox-api.flutterwave.com); the production host f4bexperience.flutterwave.com comes from the vendor's earlier Environments page and answers like the sandbox gateway (401 JSON) but is not shown in the current reference; (3) the previous stub listed api.flutterwave.cloud/{developersandbox,f4bexternal} servers, which now time out, and note the adaptor builds URLs with new URL('/path', baseUrl), which drops any path prefix on baseUrl; (4) doc example values (names, emails, phones) were deliberately not copied as examples.
